cases.name: a ruleset inside a formula
cases.python:
from pyformula import Formula
from pyruleset import otherwise, when

rule = salary + Formula((when(is_married() & children__ge(count=2), children * 25, label='family') | otherwise(lambda _: 0)), name='when(family -> (children * 25) | otherwise -> 0)')

cases.name: a ruleset
cases.python:
from pyruleset import otherwise, when

rule = (
    when(years__ge(10) & grade__eq('a'), salary * 0.2, label='senior grade a')
    | when(years__ge(10), salary * 0.1, label='senior')
    | otherwise(salary * 0.05)
)

cases.name: an unlabelled branch
cases.python:
from pyruleset import otherwise, when

rule = (
    when(grade__eq('a'), lambda _: 150)
    | otherwise(lambda _: 0)
)

cases.name: only otherwise
cases.python:

rule = Ruleset((), salary)

cases.name: a ruleset inside a branch
cases.python:
from pyformula import Formula
from pyruleset import otherwise, when

rule = (
    when(years__ge(10), 100 + Formula((when(is_married() & children__ge(count=2), children * 25, label='family') | otherwise(lambda _: 0)), name='when(family -> (children * 25) | otherwise -> 0)'), label='senior')
    | otherwise(Formula((when(is_married() & children__ge(count=2), children * 25, label='family') | otherwise(lambda _: 0)), name='when(family -> (children * 25) | otherwise -> 0)'))
)
